plan.title: Single-stage RFQ mapped and named vendor invitations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain the single-vendor lot awarding mode.

args.title: Single-stage RFQ mapped and Vendor C invitation

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and enter the requested quantity of 10.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Use the product mapping flow to invite every vendor mapped to the product.
Add the specifically named Vendor C before publication; the product should avoid creating a duplicate if it is already mapped.
Confirm that publication reached a real project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list, which is the observable participant outcome.
Locate the named vendor in the participant list.
Assert that Vendor C is present and selected for the published stage.
